description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to latest LTS versions

tasks.description: Upgrade to Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.4
tasks.requirements: Upgrade JDK to 21, Spring Boot to 3.4, Spring Framework to 6.x, and migrate javax.* to jakarta.* namespaces as needed. Update all related Spring dependencies (Spring Security, Spring Data, Spring Cloud, etc.) to versions compatible with Spring Boot 3.4. Ensure build tooling (Maven/Gradle plugins) is updated to support Java 21.
tasks.taskSummary: Successfully upgraded Java from 8 to 21 and Spring Boot from 2.7.18 to 3.4.5. Spring Framework was automatically upgraded to 6.2.x via the Spring Boot BOM. Migrated javax.persistence.* and javax.validation.constraints.* imports to jakarta.* namespaces in Photo.java. Build passes and unit tests pass.
